t: A small Feather board with a long-range LoRa radio built in.
steps: Buy the board from Adafruit or a maker store such as The Pi Hut or Pimoroni.
Pick the model for your region and check your local radio rules for that licence-free band.
Cut a wire antenna to the length in the Adafruit guide and solder it to the antenna pad.
Install CircuitPython on the board and open the Mu editor.
Copy the adafruit_rfm9x simple test example and set your band.
Repeat on a second board and watch the first message arrive.
Try the Adafruit guide for The Things Network once point to point works.
meta: Wild Open. From $30. A few stores.
